scope: Read-only inspection of existing CC-SF/CC-MF benchmark results; no simulation or solver replay

raw_schema.poses: float64 (N+1, 3), initial true pose and each integrated true pose
raw_schema.solve_nlp_times_s: float64 (N,) in inspected trials; all attempted calls, not only successes

missing_fields: selected geometric feature or switching indicator
nominal and solved predicted state/input horizon
constraint row values and slack values
native_metric_availability.reason: benchmark use_debug=false; raw traces intentionally contain only integrated poses, applied inputs, timings, fixed geometry and status metadata
native_metric_availability.valid_derived_analysis: Any residual/violation computed from these traces requires an explicit offline evaluation protocol and covariance assumptions; it is not an observation of native solver candidate or horizon constraint violations.

cautions: Trial success means goal reached, not every solver call succeeded.
Solver failure/safe-stop status cannot substitute for a chance-constraint violation.
Paired comparisons use same width and seed, and preferably common-success seed cohort.
CSV absolute trace paths refer to the source Linux machine; resolve local canonical paths under current suite root.
Success-only comparisons are conditional and do not characterize the full attempted cohort.
